digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler binding store and create dispatch
propositions: DC Lucene index eventual consistency (lag up to ~50 min) causes recover_pending to unbind a keyless-pending entry on a single negative search, removing the record that would prevent a duplicate create.

create_one's JQL dedup search misses the unindexed issue and creates a second Jira issue, because the binding entry was already unbound in step 1 and get_jira_key returns None for both absent and keyless-pending states.
recover_pending must leave keyless-pending entries PENDING on search miss (incrementing search_miss_count) rather than unbinding, so the binding record persists as a gate for the create.

create_one must defer (not drop) creates when a keyless-pending binding for that local_id exists and is younger than an index-lag grace period, consulting is_keyless_pending_within_grace at the write site in dispatch_one.create_one.
recover_pending must unbind only when BOTH search_miss_count >= 3 AND entry age exceeds grace period (default 3600s), converting a silent duplicate into a delayed-but-correct answer.
recover_pending must not count still-pending entries (those not yet corroborated as absent) toward its resolved count, so callers correctly see the binding as unsettled.
